items.title: Joint Statement from Foreign Ministers regarding RAF Fairford and Iran State Threats
items.summary: The Foreign Ministers of Australia, Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Canada, Croatia, Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Hungary, Ireland, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Netherlands, New Zealand, Norway, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, Spain, Sweden, the United Kingdom and the United States condemn in the strongest terms Iran’s use of violent attacks, including the acts of lethal plotting, arson, sabotage, cyber-attacks, and other hybrid activities against us and our partners.

items.title: Minister for Foreign Affairs takes part in EU Foreign Affairs Council
items.summary: Minister for Foreign Affairs Maria Malmer Stenergard is attending today’s EU Foreign Affairs Council in Luxembourg. Security aspects of EU enlargement, Russia’s aggression against Ukraine and the situation in the Middle East are on the agenda.

items.title: Sweden participates in Steadfast Noon
items.summary: NATO’s annual exercise Steadfast Noon begins on October 13. Sweden is participating in the exercise with fighter aircraft (JAS 39 Gripen) and personnel from the Swedish Armed Forces.

items.title: Swedish air defence unit to NATO operations in Poland
items.summary: From December, Sweden intends to provide an air defence unit for the protection of NATO’s logistics hub in Poland used for military and civilian support to Ukraine.

items.title: Sweden to provide Gripen fighter jets for NATO operation in Poland
items.summary: As of October, Sweden will support the defence of NATO’s eastern flank in Poland with fighter jets. As part of the NATO operation, the fighter jets will contribute to NATO’s Integrated Air and Missile Defence and provide protection and security for military and civil support to Ukraine.
